changes.title: Party warm
items: The paper lanterns glow warm amber now, each party area keeps to its own colour plus one, balloons gather by the lights, and pools have a moonlit far shore and the sky in them instead of reading as black holes

changes.title: Prop party
items: With ?props=gen, the party's bunting, balloon bunches and paper lanterns come in many shapes too: pennants or round flags, one or two strands with warm bulbs, round or tall lanterns, bunches on stakes or weights

changes.title: Prop kinds
items: With ?props=gen, fallen logs, fairy rings of toadstools and stone circles come in many shapes too
